sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(replace(upper(trim(p.vendor_name)), ' (FICTIONAL)', ''), '[.,''"()]', ''), ' +', ' '), ' ?/[A-Z]{2}/$', ''), '(^| )INCORPORATED( |$)', '$1INC$2'), '(^| )CORPORATION( |$)', '$1CORP$2'), '(^| )COMPANY( |$)', '$1CO$2'), '(^| )LIMITED( |$)', '$1LTD$2')) <=> v.name_norm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(replace(upper(trim(p.vendor_name)), ' (FICTIONAL)', ''), '[.,''"()]', ''), ' +', ' '), ' ?/[A-Z]{2}/$', ''), '(^| )INCORPORATED( |$)', '$1INC$2'), '(^| )CORPORATION( |$)', '$1CORP$2'), '(^| )COMPANY( |$)', '$1CO$2'), '(^| )LIMITED( |$)', '$1LTD$2')) <=> v.name_norm) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item p JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id LIMIT 1
